Hitting an app review roadblock or struggling to navigate policy enforcement can be one of the most frustrating parts of the development cycle. For our June session, we are pulling back the curtain on Google Play. Join us for a special edition or Android Office Hours where we are bringing in Dan Zilic and Akshay Kumar Singh, experts directly from the Google Play Trust & Safety team.

We will be demystifying Play policies, sharing best practices for appeals, and showing you how to proactively avoid rejections so you can publish faster and with confidence.
